title.original: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: vla.cpp：视觉-语言-动作模型的统一推理运行时
title.en: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models

inclusion_reason.zh: vla.cpp 以统一 C++ 运行时、模型 bundle、动作头执行和跨硬件后端替代模型专用 Python 栈，属于具身推理基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: vla.cpp replaces model-specific Python stacks with a unified C++ runtime, model bundles, action-head execution, and cross-hardware backends, making it embodied-inference infrastructure.

abstract.zh: vla.cpp 基于 llama.cpp 构建便携式 C++ VLA 推理运行时，以统一请求协议服务多种骨干和动作头，并原生执行带缓存视觉语言前缀的 flow-matching/扩散动作生成。
abstract.en: vla.cpp is a portable C++ VLA runtime built on llama.cpp, serving multiple backbones and action heads through one protocol and natively executing flow-matching or diffusion action generation from a cached vision-language prefix.

problem.zh: VLA 策略通常以依赖工作站 GPU 的 Python/PyTorch 工程交付，与机器人上的嵌入式硬件、低时延和可部署包要求不匹配。
problem.en: VLA policies are usually shipped as workstation-oriented Python/PyTorch projects that do not fit embedded robot hardware, low-latency execution, or self-contained deployment.

approach.zh: 运行时抽象共同的视觉语言前缀与跨注意力动作专家路径，将模型打包为自包含 bundle，并用跨硬件 roofline 分析定向优化 batch-1 GEMM。
approach.en: The runtime abstracts a shared vision-language prefix plus cross-attending action-expert path, packages models as self-contained bundles, and uses cross-hardware roofline analysis to optimize batch-one GEMM.

system_design.zh: bundle 包含权重、模型描述和 tokenizer，统一前端处理观测，缓存骨干前缀，动作头跨多个求解步生成控制序列，后端映射到桌面或嵌入式设备。
system_design.en: A bundle contains weights, model description, and tokenizer; a common frontend processes observations, caches the backbone prefix, action heads integrate control over solver steps, and backends target desktop or embedded devices.

key_results.zh: 同一 bundle 可跨多个硬件层运行并保持任务表现，针对计算受限特征设计的 GEMM 显著降低动作步时延和内存需求。
key_results.en: The same bundle runs across several hardware tiers while preserving task behavior, and a compute-aware GEMM materially reduces action-step latency and memory needs.

limitations.zh: 当前覆盖的架构和机器人任务有限，模型转换与量化可能引入误差；运行时解决推理部署，但不提供机器人安全、驱动兼容或闭环稳定保证。
limitations.en: Architecture and robot-task coverage remains limited and conversion or quantization can introduce error; the runtime addresses inference, not robot safety, driver compatibility, or closed-loop stability guarantees.

models: seven VLA architectures across five backbones and four action-head families

metrics.name: Per-step latency speedup from IMMA ladder GEMM

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
